state.paragraph: On May 14, 2013, the Transaction Committee and representatives of Goodwin Procter held a meeting by telephone conference call. The Transaction Committee discussed further the process for hiring a financial advisor for a review of strategic alternatives. Given that BofA Merrill Lynch was one of the investment banks to be invited to submit a proposal and that the CSC sale process had ended, the Transaction Committee determined to terminate BofA Merrill Lynch's engagement letter entered into for purposes of the 2011-2012 Discussions.

ledger_rows.Note: Target's outside legal counsel, first seen acting here. Later also advised the Special Committee.
The Transaction Committee decided on 05/14 to end the 2011-2012 mandate, since BofA was being invited to pitch for the sale-review role.
Re-engaged as the target's sole financial adviser for the strategic review and possible sale, chosen from three banks. Engagement letter 05/31; no buyer financing without consent.

exit.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a potential buyer withdraws, declines to bid, is told it will not advance, or is otherwise excluded from the process. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
